teaser.en: The 'black mkongolo': named not for any relationship, but because its dark bark matches the inner bark of another tree.
teaser.sw: 'Mkongolo mweusi': umepewa jina hili si kwa sababu ya uhusiano wowote, bali kwa sababu gome lake jeusi linalingana na gome la ndani la mti mwingine.
teaser.dg: *Mkongolo* 'mwiru': tauihwa hivyo kpwa sababu ni ndugu na muhi wanjina, ela kpwa sababu gophare riru rinahalana na gopha ra ndani ra muhi wanjina.

summary.en: Mkongolo mwiru is a forest tree of the Connaraceae that Digo speakers name after the colour of its bark. Its name pairs it with mkongolo (Combretum schumannii).
summary.sw: Mkongolo mwiru ni mti wa msituni wa familia ya Connaraceae ambao wasemaji wa Kidigo huupa jina kutokana na rangi ya gome lake. Jina lake linauoanisha na *mkongolo* (*Combretum schumannii*).
summary.dg: *Mkongolo mwiru* ni muhi wa tsakani wa jamii ya Connaraceae, ambao atu anaogomba Chidigo anauiha kpwa rangi ya gophare. Dzinare rinauika phamwenga na *mkongolo* (*Combretum schumannii*).

about.en:
*Mkongolo mwiru* is a tree of the coastal forest, in the small family Connaraceae. Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves, but its name comes from its dark bark.

The genus *Ellipanthus* has simple, alternate, leathery leaves and small flowers, and its fruits are small capsules that split to show a seed.
about.sw:
*Mkongolo mwiru* ni mti wa misitu ya pwani, katika familia ndogo ya Connaraceae. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani yake, lakini jina lake linatokana na gome lake jeusi.

Jenasi *Ellipanthus* ina majani sahili yanayopishana na magumu kama ngozi, maua madogo, na matunda yake ni vibumba vidogo vinavyopasuka kuonyesha mbegu.
about.dg:
*Mkongolo mwiru* ni muhi wa matsaka ga pwani, wa jamii ndide ya Connaraceae. Atu ambao Pakia wauza akaumanya kpwa makodzage, ela dzinare rinatuluka kpwa rangi nyiru ya gophare.

Mihi ya jenasi ya *Ellipanthus* ina makodza mazima gasigoganyika, ganayomera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kupishana, magumu dza chingo, na maruwa madide. Matundage ni makakaya madide ganayoahuka na kuonyesa tembe.

where.en: It grows in the dry coastal forests of Kenya and Tanzania, the same kind of forest as the Kwale kayas.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu mikavu ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania, aina ile ile ya misitu kama kaya za Kwale.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka makavu ga pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania, matsaka ga aina mwenga na ga makaya ga Kwale.

culture.en: Stem colour is one of the features Digo speakers use to tell related trees apart. Pakia gives this name as an example: the plain *mkongolo* (*Combretum schumannii*) is set against *mkongolo mwiru*, 'black mkongolo', and *mkongolo wa kundu*, 'red mkongolo'.
culture.sw: Rangi ya shina ni mojawapo ya sifa ambazo wasemaji wa Kidigo huzitumia kutofautisha miti inayohusiana. Pakia anatoa jina hili kama mfano: *mkongolo* wa kawaida (*Combretum schumannii*) unalinganishwa na *mkongolo mwiru*, 'mkongolo mweusi', na *mkongolo wa kundu*, 'mkongolo mwekundu'.
culture.dg: Rangi ya kolo ni kahi ya alama ambazo atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuzihumira kutafwautisha mihi iriyo ndugu. Pakia analavya dzina hiri dza mfwano: *mkongolo* wa kawaida (*Combretum schumannii*) unatafwautishwa na *mkongolo mwiru*, '*mkongolo* mwiru', na *mkongolo wa kundu*, '*mkongolo* wa kundu'.

names.en: *Mkongolo mwiru* means 'black mkongolo'. Pakia explains that the plain *mkongolo* (*Combretum schumannii*) has brownish bark that peels off to show a paler bark underneath, and the bark of this species is compared with it and described as black (*mwiru*). The two trees belong to different families. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: *Mkongolo mwiru* maana yake ni 'mkongolo mweusi'. Pakia anaeleza kwamba *mkongolo* wa kawaida (*Combretum schumannii*) una gome la rangi ya hudhurungi linalobambuka kuonyesha gome jeupe zaidi chini yake, na gome la spishi hii hulinganishwa nalo na kuelezwa kuwa jeusi (*mwiru*). Miti hii miwili ni ya familia tofauti. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili katika vyanzo.
names.dg: Mana ya *mkongolo mwiru* ni '*mkongolo* mwiru'. Pakia anaeleza kukala *mkongolo* wa kawaida (*Combretum schumannii*) una gopha ra rangi ya dongo rinaroandulika na kuonyesa gopha ra ndani ra rangi ngushu-ngushu; gopha ra muhi hinyu rinalinganishwa naro na rinaelezwa kukala dziru (*mwiru*). Mihi hino miri ni ya jamii tafwauti. Maandiko tagana dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

reason.en: The plain mkongolo it is named against
reason.sw: Mkongolo (mgongolo) wa kawaida unaolinganishwa nao kwa jina
